title: Driver education fee.
bodyText: The board may assess a fee for each student enrolling in the driver education program. All such fees collected shall be deposited into the state treasury to the credit of the general fund.
bodyHtml: [§302A-416]  Driver education fee.  The board may assess a fee for each student enrolling in the driver education program.  All such fees collected shall be deposited into the state treasury to the credit of the general fund. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
